movie.overview: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.
movie.tagline: The story of an orphan who would be king.
movie.title: Mufasa: The Lion King

recommendations.title: The Lion King 1½
recommendations.original_title: The Lion King 1½
recommendations.overview: Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog are best pals and the unsung heroes of the African savanna. This prequel to the smash Disney animated adventure takes you back -- way back -- before Simba's adventure began. You'll find out all about Timon and Pumbaa and tag along as they search for the perfect home and attempt to raise a rambunctious lion cub.

recommendations.title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
recommendations.original_title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
recommendations.overview: The circle of life continues for Simba, now fully grown and in his rightful place as the king of Pride Rock. Simba and Nala have given birth to a daughter, Kiara who's as rebellious as her father was. But Kiara drives her parents to distraction when she catches the eye of Kovu, the son of the evil lioness, Zira. Will Kovu steal Kiara's heart?

recommendations.title: The Lion King
recommendations.original_title: The Lion King
recommendations.overview: Simba idolizes his father, King Mufasa, and takes to heart his own royal destiny. But not everyone in the kingdom celebrates the new cub's arrival. Scar, Mufasa's brother—and former heir to the throne—has plans of his own. The battle for Pride Rock is ravaged with betrayal, tragedy and drama, ultimately resulting in Simba's exile. With help from a curious pair of newfound friends, Simba will have to figure out how to grow up and take back what is rightfully his.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time V: The Mysterious Island
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time V: The Mysterious Island
recommendations.overview: A plague of locusts strikes the Great Valley, decimating the plants and forcing the dinosaurs to migrate in search of food. When the adults in the herd begin fighting over the scarce resources, young Littlefoot and his friends Petrie, Cera, Ducky and Spike split off from the main group, becoming stranded on an island after their path was destroyed by a tsunami. As they search for a way off the island, they encounter an old acquaintance who may become friend or foe.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time XI: Invasion of the Tinysauruses
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time XI: Invasion of the Tinysauruses
recommendations.overview: Littlefoot and his friends return in another adventure. But this time, they aren't the smallest dinosaurs in the valley anymore.

recommendations.title: Tarzan & Jane
recommendations.original_title: Tarzan & Jane
recommendations.overview: With the first anniversary of her wedding to Tarzan beckoning, Jane ponders how to make it the perfect English celebration.

recommendations.title: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
recommendations.original_title: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
recommendations.overview: A blue harvest moon will rise, allowing the fairies to use a precious moonstone to restore the Pixie Dust Tree, the source of all their magic. But when Tinker Bell accidentally puts all of Pixie Hollow in jeopardy, she must venture out across the sea on a secret quest to set things right.

recommendations.title: Belle's Magical World
recommendations.original_title: Belle's Magical World
recommendations.overview: Belle, the Beast, Lumiere, Cogsworth and the rest of those zany castle residents use their imaginations to embark on three magical, storybook adventures. This direct-to-video anthology serves as a "sequel" to Disney's animated hit film. In "The Perfect World," Belle and the Beast learn about forgiveness. In "Fifi's Folly," Lumiere's girlfriend is jealous of his bond with Belle. And in "Broken Wing," the Beast learns to be kind to an injured bird.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time VII: The Stone of Cold Fire
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time VII: The Stone of Cold Fire
recommendations.overview: Littlefoot and his pals set off in search of a "stone of cold fire" that fell from the night sky. Since he's the only one who has seen it though, nobody really believes him. Petrie's uncle Pterano offers support only because he thinks the stone has secret powers and wants it for himself but conceals this from the rest. The young dinos must figure out the truth, before Pterano gets the power.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time XIII: The Wisdom of Friends
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time XIII: The Wisdom of Friends
recommendations.overview: Littlefoot learns a series of important lessons following an incident that nearly costs his grandmother her life. Soon afterwards, three dinosaurs arrive claiming they have lost their way.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time III: The Time of the Great Giving
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time III: The Time of the Great Giving
recommendations.overview: A huge meteorite has plunged into the Great Valley, cutting off the water supply and causing tension among the once-peaceful dinosaurs.  While the adults argue and turn against one another, Littlefoot and his friends venture out to find a new source of water, only to be constantly bullied by a trio of older dinosaurs. The journey becomes a fight for survival when the group is cornered by a pack of Velociraptors and trapped by a sudden wildfire.

recommendations.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
recommendations.original_title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
recommendations.overview: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends are surprised when a green pig suggests that they put aside their differences and unite to fight a common threat. Aggressive birds from an island covered in ice are planning to use an elaborate weapon to destroy the fowl and swine.

recommendations.title: The Lion Guard: Return of the Roar
recommendations.original_title: The Lion Guard: Return of the Roar
recommendations.overview: Set in the African savannah, the film follows Kion as he assembles the members of the 'Lion Guard'. Throughout the film, the diverse team of young animals will learn how to utilize each of their unique abilities to solve problems and accomplish tasks to maintain balance within the Circle of Life, while also introducing viewers to the vast array of animals that populate the prodigious African landscape.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time XIV: Journey of the Brave
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time XIV: Journey of the Brave
recommendations.overview: On a day known to the dinosaurs as "Treasure Day", Bron becomes stuck in the Mysterious Beyond. This event urges the young Longneck Littlefoot to take his friends on a quest to the Fire Mountain to save his father. Along the way, they befriend a Flyer.

recommendations.title: The Jungle Book 2
recommendations.original_title: The Jungle Book 2
recommendations.overview: Mowgli has been living in the man-village with his little stepbrother Ranjan and his best friend Shanti. But the man-cub still has that jungle rhythm in his heart, and he misses his old buddies Baloo and Bagheera. When Mowgli wanders back to the wild for some swingin' fun, he soon finds the man-eating tiger Shere Khan is lurking in the shadows and planning his revenge.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time IV: Journey Through the Mists
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time IV: Journey Through the Mists
recommendations.overview: Littlefoot’s grandfather falls gravely ill, and the only hope for his recovery is the "Golden Night Flower" found in the treacherous Land of the Mists. Along with his loyal friends, Littlefoot embarks on a journey to retrieve the cure, joined by a shy newcomer named Ali, a long-necked dinosaur from a migrating herd. As they navigate the foggy, swamp-filled terrain, they are hunted by a pair of predators—a sharp-eyed bird and a massive crocodile—and must overcome their mistrust of the unfamiliar environment.

recommendations.title: The Land Before Time XII: The Great Day of the Flyers
recommendations.original_title: The Land Before Time XII: The Great Day of the Flyers
recommendations.overview: As the Great Day of the Flyers nears, the Great Valley's flying youngsters are eager to participate in the annual exhibition to show off their skills. Everyone, that is, except free-spirited pterodactyl Petrie, whose individualism causes problems when it comes to staying in formation. Enter his dinosaur pals Littlefoot, Cera, Spike and Ducky, who encourage Petrie to embrace his uniqueness.

recommendations.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
recommendations.original_title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
recommendations.overview: Following an unproductive harvest season, it’s up to Maya and her brave friends to save their hive by competing in a series of games.

recommendations.title: Maya the Bee: The Golden Orb
recommendations.original_title: Maya the Bee: The Golden Orb
recommendations.overview: When Maya, a headstrong little bee, and her best friend Willy, rescue an ant princess, they find themselves in the middle of an epic bug battle that will take them to strange new worlds and test their friendship to its limits.

recommendations.title: Storm Boy
recommendations.original_title: Storm Boy
recommendations.overview: Storm Boy lives a lonely life with his reclusive father on a desolate coastline, but when he forms a close bond with a pelican, Mr. Percival, his life takes a new and unexpected turn.
